sn35.87:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandaka nivāpe.
sn35.87:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ca sāriputto āyasmā ca mahācundo āyasmā ca channo gijjhakūṭe pabbate viharanti.
sn35.87:1.3: tena kho pana samayena yena āyasmā channo ābādhiko hoti dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
sn35.87:1.4: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā mahācundo tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahācundaṃ etadavoca:
sn35.87:1.6: evamāvusoti kho āyasmā mahācundo āyasmato sāriputtassa paccassosi.
sn35.87:2.1: atha kho āyasmā ca sāriputto āyasmā ca mahācundo yenāyasmā channo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdiṃsu. nisajja kho āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ channaṃ etadavoca:
sn35.87:2.2: “kacci te āvuso khamanīyaṃ, kacci yāpanīyaṃ, kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti, no abhikkamanti, paṭikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no abhikkamoti.
sn35.87:3.1: na me āvuso sāriputta khamanīyaṃ, na yāpanīyaṃ, bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti, abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamo.
sn35.87:3.2: seyyathāpi āvuso, balavā puriso tiṇhena sikharena muddhānaṃ abhimantheyya, evameva kho āvuso adhimattā vātā muddhānaṃ upahananti.
sn35.87:3.3: na me āvuso khamanīyaṃ, na yāpanīyaṃ …pe… no paṭikkamo.
sn35.87:3.4: seyyathāpi āvuso balavā puriso daḷhena varattakhaṇḍena sīse sīsaveṭhaṃ dadeyya, evameva kho āvuso, adhimattā sīse sīse vedanā.
sn35.87:3.5: na me āvuso khamanīyaṃ, na yāpanīyaṃ …pe… no paṭikkamo.
sn35.87:3.6: seyyathāpi āvuso dakkho goghātako vā goghātakantevāsī vā tiṇhena govikantanena kucchiṃ parikanteyya, evameva kho āvuso adhimattā vātā kucchiṃ parikantanti.
sn35.87:3.7: na me āvuso khamanīyaṃ, na yāpanīyaṃ, …pe… no paṭikkamo.
sn35.87:3.8: seyyathāpi āvuso, dve balavanto purisā dubbalataraṃ purisaṃ nānābāhāsu gahetvā aṅgārakāsuyā santāpeyyuṃ, samparitāpeyyuṃ, evameva kho āvuso, adhimatto kāyasmiṃ ḍāho.
sn35.87:3.9: na me āvuso khamanīyaṃ, na yāpanīyaṃ, bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā. abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti, abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamo.
sn35.87:3.10: satthaṃ āvuso sāriputta, āharissāmi nāvakaṅkhāmi jīvitanti.
sn35.87:4.2: yāpetāyasmā channo, yāpentaṃ mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ channaṃ icchāma.
sn35.87:4.3: sace āyasmato channassa natthi sappāyāni bhojanāni, ahaṃ āyasmato channassa sappāyāni bhojanāni pariyesissāmi.
sn35.87:4.4: sace āyasmato channassa natthi sappāyāni bhesajjāni, ahaṃ āyasmato channassa sappāyāni bhesajjāni pariyesissāmi.
sn35.87:4.5: sace āyasmato channassa natthi patirūpā upaṭṭhākā, ahaṃ āyasmantaṃ channaṃ upaṭṭhahissāmi.
sn35.87:4.7: yāpetāyasmā channo, yāpentaṃ mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ channaṃ icchāmāti.
sn35.87:5.1: na me āvuso sāriputta natthi sappāyāni bhojanāni,
sn35.87:5.7: api ca me āvuso satthā pariciṇṇo dīgharattaṃ manāpeneva no amanāpena.
sn35.87:5.8: etaṃ hi āvuso, sāvakassa patirūpaṃ yaṃ satthāraṃ paricareyya manāpeneva no amanāpena. taṃ
sn35.87:5.9: anupavajjaṃ channo bhikkhu satthaṃ āharissatīti, evametaṃ āvuso sāriputta dhārehīti.
sn35.87:6.1: puccheyyāma mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ channaṃ kañcideva desaṃ, sace āyasmā channo okāsaṃ karoti pañhassa veyyākaraṇāyāti.
sn35.87:7.1: cakkhuṃ āvuso channa, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme “etaṃ mama, eso’hamasmi, eso me attā”ti samanupassasi. sotaṃ āvuso channa …pe… ghānaṃ āvuso channa …pe…
sn35.87:7.2: jivhaṃ āvuso channa …pe… jivhāviññāṇaṃjivhāviññāṇa viññātabbe dhamme: “etaṃ mama, eso’hamasmi eso me attā”ti samanupassasi kāyaṃ āvuso channa …pe…
sn35.87:7.3: manaṃ āvuso channa, manoviññāṇaṃ manoviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme “etaṃ mama, eso’hamasmi, eso me attā”ti samanupassasīti.
sn35.87:8.1: cakkhuṃ āvuso sāriputta, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme: “netaṃ mama, neso’hamasmi, na meso attā”ti samanupassāmi, sotaṃ āvuso sāriputta, …pe… ghānaṃ āvuso sāriputta …pe…
sn35.87:8.2: jivhaṃ āvuso sāriputta, jivhāviññāṇaṃ jivhāviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme “netaṃ mama neso’hamasmi na meso attā”ti samanupassāmi, kāyaṃ āvuso sāriputta …pe…
sn35.87:8.3: manaṃ āvuso sāriputta, manoviññāṇaṃ manoviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme “netaṃ mama, neso’hamasmi, na meso attā”ti samanupassāmīti.
sn35.87:9.1: cakkhusmiṃ āvuso channa, cakkhuviññāṇe cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbesu dhammesu kiṃ disvā kiṃ abhiññāya cakkhuṃ cakkhuviññāṇaṃ cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme “netaṃ mama, neso’hamasmi, na meso attā”ti samanupassasi? sotasmiṃ āvuso channa …pe… ghānasmiṃ āvuso channa …pe…
sn35.87:9.2: jivhāya āvuso channa jivhāviññāṇe jivhāviññāṇaviññātabbesu dhammesu kiṃ disvā kiṃ abhiññāya jivhaṃ jivhāviññāṇaṃ jivhāviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme “netaṃ mama neso’hamasmi, na meso attā”ti samanupassasi? kāyasmiṃ āvuso channa …pe…
sn35.87:9.3: manasmiṃ āvuso channa, manoviññāṇe manoviññāṇaviññātabbesu dhammesu kiṃ disvā kiṃ abhiññāya manaṃ manoviññāṇaṃ manoviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme “netaṃ mama, neso’hamasmi, na meso attā”ti samanupassasi?
sn35.87:10.1: cakkhusmiṃ āvuso sāriputta, cakkhuviññāṇe cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbesu dhammesu nirodhaṃ disvā nirodhaṃ abhiññāya cakkhuṃ cakkhuviññāṇaṃ cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme “netaṃ mama, neso’hamasmi, na meso attā”ti samanupassāmi. sotasmiṃ āvuso sāriputta …pe… ghānasmiṃ āvuso sāriputta …pe…
sn35.87:10.2: jivhāya āvuso sāriputta, jivhāviññāṇe jivhāviññāṇaviññātabbesu dhammesu nirodhaṃ disvā nirodhaṃ abhiññāya jivhaṃ jivhāviññāṇaṃ jivhāviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme “netaṃ mama, neso’hamasmi, na meso attā”ti samanupassāmi, kāyasmiṃ āvuso sāriputta …pe…
sn35.87:10.3: manasmiṃ āvuso sāriputta, manoviññāṇe manoviññāṇaviññātabbesu dhammesu nirodhaṃ disvā nirodhaṃ abhiññāya manaṃ manoviññāṇaṃ manoviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme “netaṃ mama, neso’hamasmi, na meso attāti samanupassāmīti.
sn35.87:11.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā mahācundo āyasmantaṃ channaṃ etadavoca:
sn35.87:11.2: “tasmātiha āvuso channa, idampi tassa bhagavato sāsanaṃ niccakappaṃ sādhukaṃ manasikātabbaṃ:
sn35.87:11.8: cutūpapāte asati nevidha na huraṃ na ubhayamantarena.
sn35.87:12.1: atha kho āyasmā ca sāriputto āyasmā ca mahācundo āyasmantaṃ channaṃ iminā ovādena ovaditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamiṃsu.
sn35.87:12.2: atha kho āyasmā channo acirapakkantesu tesu āyasmantesu satthaṃ āharesi.
sn35.87:13.1: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn35.87:13.4: nanu te sāriputta, channena bhikkhunā sammukhāyeva anupavajjatā byākatāti.
sn35.87:13.7: honti hete sāriputta, channassa bhikkhuno mittakulāni suhajjakulāni upavajjakulāni.
sn35.87:13.8: na kho panāhaṃ sāriputta, ettāvatā saupavajjoti vadāmi.
sn35.87:13.9: yo kho sāriputta imañca kāyaṃ nikkhipati, aññañca kāyaṃ upādiyati, tamahaṃ saupavajjoti vadāmi.
